Hello,

Further to our previous messages, we note that the remaining AED 1,400 is still outstanding.

No valid justification or supporting documentation has been provided to substantiate this deduction.

As already mentioned, the matter has now been formally escalated to DET.

However, we remain open to resolving this amicably.

Please confirm that the outstanding AED 1,400 will be refunded within 48 hours to avoid further escalation.

Thank you.
